237:t_000:40.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「Understood. I will disclose $$人類銀河同盟$$ intelligence record X12030702.」

237:t_000:41.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「The $$ヒディアーズ#keyword$$ are believed to have their main base at the galaxy's central point.」

237:t_000:42.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「Several other species hostile to humanity have also been confirmed there. The galactic center is the Alliance's ultimate strategic attack target.」

237:t_000:43.en:
$$キャシー$$
「A $$ヒディアーズ#keyword$$ nest...」

237:t_000:45.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「That probably means $$宇宙怪獣$$.」

237:t_000:46.en:
$$レド$$
「$$チェインバー#pilot$$, display information on species hostile to humanity other than $$宇宙怪獣$$.」

237:t_000:47.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「My unit was not expected to engage them directly, so detailed information on those species was not recorded.」

237:t_000:49.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「...Perhaps $$サイデリアル$$'s main forces are deployed near the galactic center to exterminate them.」

237:t_000:50.en:
$$ブライト$$
「Species hostile to humanity... So-called $$バアル$$...」

237:t_000:51.en:
$$オットー$$
「Is $$サイデリアル$$ trying to use Earth's $$次元力$$ to exterminate $$バアル$$...?!」

237:t_000:52.en:
$$レイアム$$
「...From one perspective, that could be seen as acting for the entire universe.」

237:t_000:54.en:
$$ブライト$$
「XO $$レイアム$$ is right. Remember the records left in the $$プロトカルチャー$$ ruins.」

237:t_000:55.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「...The force that seeks to vanish tries to erase the force of life, in order to erase the force that seeks to exist...」

237:t_000:56.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「That gives rise to $$バアル$$...」

237:t_000:57.en:
$$ブライト$$
「In other words, if we can defeat $$バアル$$, the universe's rebirth... its collapse, will not occur.」

237:t_000:58.en:
$$ブライト$$
「Of course, once $$バアル$$ destroys us, whether the universe collapses or anything else happens will be irrelevant to us.」

237:t_000:59.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「$$サイデリアル$$ must know that fact...」

237:t_000:60.en:
$$オットー$$
「I understand the logic, but that doesn't make me willing to submit to invaders.」

237:t_000:61.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「...It's a shame. If they recognized us as fellow inhabitants of this universe, we could have fought $$バアル$$ together...」

237:t_000:62.en:
$$ブライト$$
「...I wondered what would become of us when we were sent to the galactic center. We've obtained all sorts of information in ways I never imagined.」

237:t_000:63.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Now we need a way to take it back to Earth...」

237:t_000:64.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「At the galactic center, I thought we could get home if we had enough time. But now we don't even know what world we're in...」

237:t_000:65.en:
$$フェルト$$
「Be careful! I've detected a distortion in the dimensional boundary!」

237:t_000:66.en:
$$ミレイナ$$
「Something is transferring into this space!」

237:t_001:0.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「All units, prepare to launch! We don't know what's coming, so stay alert!」

237:t_001:1.en:
$$キャシー$$
「A $$時空震動$$ is coming!」

237:t_002:0.en:
$$モニカ$$
「$$バジュラ$$ and $$ヒディアーズ#keyword$$! There are $$宇宙怪獣$$ and $$インベーダー#robot$$, too!」

237:t_002:1.en:
$$ボビー$$
「All the so-called species hostile to humanity are here!」

237:t_002:2.en:
$$キャシー$$
「The forces show no signs of coordination, but they seem to be targeting us!」

237:t_002:3.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「They're trying to eliminate us for setting foot in their territory...!」

237:t_002:4.en:
$$ブライト$$
「We'll intercept them! All units, launch!」

237:t_003:1.en:
$$アムロ$$
($$カミーユ$$, $$ガロード$$ and the others experienced it, too. I can't dismiss it as a dream or a vision...)

237:t_003:3.en:
$$カイエン$$
「Don't space out, $$アマタ$$! The enemy's almost here!」

237:t_003:4.en:
$$アマタ$$
「I'm fine, $$カイエン$$. I can do this... I have to.」

237:t_003:5.en:
$$ゼシカ$$
「What...? You're hardly spacing out. You're raring to go.」

237:t_003:7.en:
$$アマタ$$
(Something inside me is telling me... this place... is dangerous...)

237:t_003:9.en:
$$ブライト$$
「All units! We don't know where we are, so avoid unnecessary damage as much as possible!」

237:t_003:10.en:
$$ブライト$$
「Assume any damage to our ships could be fatal! Protect the ships and strike any enemy that approaches!」

237:t_004:3.en:
$$セツコ$$
「Miss $$スズネ$$! What's wrong with $n?」

237:t_004:4.en:
$$スズネ$$
「It's nothing serious. I'll have him continue fighting.」

237:t_004:6.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Let's do this, $n. Wherever we are, we have to carve a path forward with our own strength...!」

237:t_005:0.en:
$$ブライト$$
「All units, begin the attack! We will return to Earth!」

237:t_006:0.en:
$$ガロード$$
「We managed to pull it off...」

237:t_006:1.en:
$$ロラン$$
「But if those things keep attacking us over and over...」

237:t_007:0.en:
$$ガロード$$
「What?! The enemy was suddenly destroyed!」

237:t_009:1.en:
$$ブレラ$$
「Since they're with the $$アンゲロイ$$ types, we should assume they're $$サイデリアル$$ forces.」

237:t_009:4.en:
$$バナージ$$
「This is different from the last battle... When I look at them...」

237:t_009:5.en:
$$キラ$$
「My will to fight is fading...」

237:t_009:7.en:
$$スズネ$$
「No. It's awe in the face of overwhelming power.」

237:t_009:9.en:
$$スズネ$$
「When a small child faces an adult's anger, the child does everything possible to beg forgiveness.」

237:t_009:10.en:
$$スズネ$$
「They don't rebel or resist. They apologize and grovel, waiting for the anger to subside, exposing their utter helplessness.」
